math_cards: Microscopic thermal energy and macroscopic hydrodynamic drag dictate the stochastic diffusion coefficient
Stochastic random walks disperse with the square root of time rather than linear ballistic velocity
Deterministic Stokes drag balances white-noise thermal bombardment impulses from trillions of solvent molecules
desktop_mission.voice_math: The core physics: the Einstein diffusion relation, mean square displacement scaling, and the Langevin stochastic force balance.

math_steps.note: Thermal white noise kicks drive stochastic particle velocity updates against viscous drag
math_steps.code:
// 3. Langevin stochastic thermal impulse and velocity integration
val kickIntensity = (rmsVelocityUmS * 0.08f * thermalSpeedScale / max(mediumViscosityCP.pow(0.4f), 0.1f))
val kickForce = Offset(cos(kickAngle) * kickIntensity, sin(kickAngle) * kickIntensity)
particleVel = (particleVel * damping) + (kickForce * 3.5f)
